newsitem.title: USA: Saga Communications names finance chief.
newsitem.headline: Saga Communications names finance chief.

text.p: Saga Communications Inc said Tuesday it had appointed Ed Ruffley as chief financial officer, vice president and treasurer.
Ruffley succeeds Norman McKee, who recently left the company to pursue other business opportunities. Ruffley said the departure was amicable.

For the last 10 years, Ruffley has served as vice president and chief financial officer of Federal Broadcasting Co, which was recently sold to Raycom Media Inc, a private firm based in Bloomfield Hills, Mich.
Saga said that when pending acquisitions are completed, it will own broadcast operations in 12 markets, including 23 FM and 13 AM radio stations, as well as one television station.
